parent.previous_result: F116 learned 8-logit cost policy tied TRAIN-only Beta on all four guard groups; bounded public feasibility not incremental scientific superiority

question: Can a resource-bounded TRAIN-only relational context interaction improve noisy source-evidence acquisition across unseen graph encodings beyond an equally informed empirical per-channel-per-relation Bayesian baseline?

data.case_balancing: train and each guard have all 4 channels,4 costs,16 ordered role pairs equally represented; train 4/cell, guard 2/cell
data.public_context_equality: two consecutive path roles match, independent of role renaming and edge storage order

model.candidate: 10 parameter logistic conditional-sensor-reliability with 4 per-channel biases, 1 learned shared role-equality interaction, 1 intercept and 4 learned availability logits
model.input: public channel,price,two public typed path edges; no hidden source, noise seed, GUARD label or response before query
model.feature_qualification: role-equality detector is engineered; candidate learns weights, NOT learned unrestricted graph representation
model.learning_method: full batch Bernoulli negative-log-likelihood gradient on TRAIN only

preregistered_screens.integrity: SOURCE_BOUND_SHA, F116 source and freeze unchanged, all cell counts exact, all 2048 GUARD rows for all arms archived, source identity disjoint, no hidden targets or sensor responses in inference before query
preregistered_screens.bounded_candidate: pooled candidate utility strictly greater than always-query and always-abstain
preregistered_screens.incremental: candidate strictly better than context-matched TRAIN-only Beta for each of 4 GUARD blocks and by at least 12 pooled utility units
preregistered_screens.negative_result: failing candidate or incremental screen must be recorded as NEGATIVE, never cause engineering CI failure
